messages.author: bccf789db78f8994
messages.subject: LOD differences for 2 analyses
parts:
Hi there,

I am interested in seeing the differences in LOD score for two different analyses, and plotting this output. 

I am thinking something like this:

out1 <- scan1(pr1, dat1$pheno, Xcovar=Xcovar1)
out2 <- scan1(pr2, dat2$pheno, Xcovar=Xcovar2)

Then a plot of the LOD scores for (out2 - out1). Kind of like the opposite of rbind(out1, out2) I think(?)

Thanks for your time!
Anna

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] LOD differences for 2 analyses
parts:
You should be able to just subtract them.

    plot(out1 - out2, map, ylim=c(-2,2) )

karl
